subject: Provisional concession request — safety net discount for phased multimodel rollout
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@stellarfy.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-28T15:12:00Z
Subject: Delay in multimodel launch — request for short-term credit/safety net

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. I wanted to follow up in writing: our engineering team has confirmed a ~6 week delay to the multimodel routing component we planned to use with Redwood's multiserve API. That delay directly impacts our go-live PS timeline and the token volume we had committed for Q3.

Given the timing (we already signed the commercial MSA and have an onboarding SOW), we need to request a provisional commercial safety net — either a short-term discount or a credit allowance — to keep the pilot financially viable while we wait for the feature. We value Redwood's flexibility but need a quick yes/no from your side so we can present to our CFO.

Can you let me know what options are possible at the account executive / commercial lead level, and if exec signoff will be required? I can loop in Legal if we need a short amendment.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Director of Platform Partnerships
Stellarfy

Attachments: stellarfy_impact_summary.pdf (pdf, 210KB)
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@stellarfy.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-29T08:09:00Z
Subject: Re: Delay in multimodel launch — request for short-term credit/safety net

Hi Elena — appreciate the note and for sharing the impact summary.

Short version: we can offer a provisional accommodation, but I need to coordinate internally on the form (credit vs. temporary rate cap vs. one-off discount) and the approval path. I looped in Marissa (AE on the deal) and Karthik (sales leader) and Laura in Finance to triage.

Requested from me to internal team: what size of concession preserves revenue runway while keeping Stellarfy's pilot on track, and what guardrails (timebox, usage thresholds, DocuSign amendment) we need so we can reopen to the original economics once the feature ships.

Elena: can you confirm the exact expected committed token run-rate for July — September under current assumptions? That will help our calculation sheet.

I will get back within 48 hours with a proposed term sheet.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-29T12:45:00Z
Subject: RE: Delay in multimodel launch — request for short-term credit/safety net

Team — quick thoughts:

- This is a strategic pilot (Stellarfy is in PoC + committed to scale if performance meets SLAs). We want to retain momentum.
- Financially, we should aim for a timeboxed concession (6–8 weeks max) tied to obvious triggers (feature ship or net new threshold).
- Approvals: I can greenlight up to a 10% revenue concession or a $50k credit (whichever is lower) without exec escalation. Anything above that moves to VP/GM review.

Marissa — please run the numbers against the attached pricing-impact-calculation.xlsx and propose an explicit offer by EOD tomorrow.

Karthik
SVP, Commercial
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@stellarfy.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T09:33:00Z
Subject: RE: Delay in multimodel launch — request for short-term credit/safety net

Hi all — ran the numbers (see attached workbook). Key assumptions from Stella: 1) committed pilot volume = 60M tokens for Jul–Sep, 2) expected revenue at list = $120k for the quarter.

Proposal (provisional):
- Option A: $30k credit applied to invoices for Jul and Aug (timeboxed, clawback if they don't hit baseline usage once multinode routing ships).
- Option B: 12% temporary discount on generation calls for Jul–Aug, capped at $35k.

Recommended: Option A (credit) — simpler for billing and quicker to execute via amendment + DocuSign. Conditions: Stellarfy signs a short amendment, acknowledges feature ship milestone (INF-9912) as termination trigger, and agrees to retain minimum committed run-rate for Oct+ (to be detailed).

If we stay within Karthik's guardrail, this is within my authority; above it we need VP approval.

Attaching pricing-impact-calculation.xlsx and draft provisional-concession-term-sheet.docx for internal review.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing-impact-calculation.xlsx (xlsx), provisional-concession-term-sheet.docx (docx)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-01T17:56:00Z
Subject: RE: Delay in multimodel launch — request for short-term credit/safety net

Thanks for the analysis. Finance position: we can approve Option A up to $30k as a provisional concession provided the following are in place:
1) The concession is timeboxed to 60 days and administratively applied as a one-time credit;
2) A short amendment is signed by the customer and countersigned by Sales; the amendment calls out the ship milestone (INF-9912) that automatically terminates the concession;
3) A clause requiring a minimum committed run-rate for Oct–Dec (we should specify a retention floor equal to at least 75% of the original projected tokens) to avoid full clawback;
4) Legal to review the amendment language (I will route to Legal once Sales confirms final wording).

If Marketing or Growth want a heavier concession (e.g., >$30k or longer timebox), that needs VP/CEO oversight.

I am OK to sign off on the finance side once Legal signs off.

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@stellarfy.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, legal@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-05T09:23:00Z
Subject: Final — provisional concession approved (terms + next steps)

Hi Elena — quick update and next steps.

We can proceed with Option A: a one-time $30k credit applied across July/August invoices, timeboxed to 60 days. Conditions: short amendment to the MSA capturing the concession, the INF-9912 ship milestone as the automatic termination trigger, and the minimum commit floor for Oct–Dec as Laura described. Legal is copied and will circulate the amendment for signature.

What I need from you to finish:
- Confirm the final committed token estimate for Jul–Sep (if any adjustments are needed to the numbers Marissa used).
- Confirm Stellarfy Legal (cc'd) can review and accept the amendment flow.

I will send the DocuSign envelope with the amendment and the pricing worksheet once we have your confirmation. Thanks for working through this — want to keep the pilot momentum.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: docuSign-envelope-stellarfy-amendment (link: https://docuSign.example.com/envelope/ABC-123)
